module autovcoder_108528 (
    input clk,
    input rstn,
    input a,
    output reg out
);

  localparam S0 = 2'b00;
  localparam S1 = 2'b01;

  reg [1:0] state;
  reg [1:0] next_state;

  always @(negedge rstn or posedge clk) begin
    if (!rstn) begin
      state <= S0;
    end else begin
      state <= next_state;
    end
  end

  always @(state or a) begin
    case (state)
      S0: begin
        if (a == 0) begin
          next_state = S0;
        end else begin
          next_state = S1;
        end
      end
      S1: begin
        next_state = a ? S1 : S0;
      end
      default: begin
        next_state = S0;
      end
    endcase
  end

  always @(state) begin
    case (state)
      S0: begin
        out <= 1'b0;
      end
      S1: begin
        out <= 1'b1;
      end
      default: begin
        out <= 1'bx;
      end
    endcase
  end

endmodule
